beats.summary: Michael misunderstands the walk-a-thon donation as a flat amount rather than per mile, causing tension with Oscar.

evidence.snippet: Michael: I just thought it was kind of a flat, you know… 25 dollar, one-time donation.
Oscar: It says it right on the sheet. Look, look at the sheet. It says, "However many dollars per mile."

beats.summary: Michael hosts a birthday party for Meredith with humorous and teasing cards from coworkers.

evidence.snippet: Michael: Read it out loud. And say who wrote everything so we know whose is the best.
Meredith: "Happy Bird-day" Um… "Meredith, good news. You're not actually a year older because you work here, where time stands still."

beats.summary: Michael reveals he donated $25 per mile to Oscar's nephew's walkathon, surprising the office.

beats.summary: Dwight embraces the betrayal of Jim as part of office politics, showing no remorse.

evidence.snippet: Dwight: Do I feel bad about betraying Jim? Not at all. That's the game.
